nodes.label: User Story 1: Baseline Smoke Coverage (minimal)
nodes.rationale: Without a baseline run every other comparison is meaningless; minimal is the cheapest end-to-end run and the regression-safe floor below which the archetype is broken.

nodes.label: User Story 2: Stress Coverage of Co-Enabled Flags (full)
nodes.rationale: Co-enabled flags are the second-most likely place for the post-processor to misbehave (conditional branches interact); full is the cheapest way to exercise the stress surface — without it every individual flag looks fine but combinations blow up.

nodes.label: User Story 3: Custom Attributes Entity Generation (custom-attributes)
nodes.rationale: The only scenario where mvn verify is not sufficient as an acceptance signal: the generated entity's field list must match the declared custom_entity_attributes_list, so structural assertions on the output are required.

nodes.label: User Story 4: Binding Properties Coverage (per sub-module)
nodes.rationale: Binding properties is a large multi-flag surface (one parent + 5 sub-flags); the Constitution requires immutable and mutable variants tested independently — this story is what makes that auditable (Principle IV).

nodes.label: FR-004 dependency rule (parent off means children not exercised)
nodes.rationale: Keeps the matrix free of semantically invalid combinations: when a parent flag is false, the related child flags are not exercised in that fixture (the DEPENDS_ON rule encoded in property-*.xml).

nodes.label: FR-007 offline-runnable constraint (no network/Git/Docker calls)
nodes.rationale: Tests must remain deterministic and offline-runnable once the archetype and its dependencies are cached; verify.groovy must perform no network calls, so a future edit introducing one fails the offline check.

nodes.label: FR-009 clean local install assumption
nodes.rationale: An outdated local cache cannot mask a real regression — the suite assumes a clean local install before each run (Constitution Principle VI: validate before blaming the code).

nodes.label: FR-011 bash_script/ exclusion
nodes.rationale: The automated matrix must not modify, replace or interact with the existing bash_script/ tooling so the human-facing interactive flow remains untouched.

nodes.label: FR-012 security+observability exclusion (historical)
nodes.rationale: JWT + Logback + cPanel/ELK combinations were excluded so they could be addressed in a separate future assessment; historically the full/ fixture now exercises exactly that combination (all flags on), so the exclusion no longer describes the matrix.
